controles.affirmation: Marsh Ltd. courtier en assurance-credit de Greensill a partir de 2014 ; les demandeurs des procedures australiennes ont reclame environ 5 Mds $ plus interets et frais
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q 21/07/2026 : "From 2014, Marsh Ltd. was engaged by Greensill Capital (UK) Limited and its affiliates as its insurance broker" ; "The 36 applicants in the omnibus trade credit insurance policy litigation among Greensill and its insurers and loss payees in Australia (the 'Australian proceedings') have collectively claimed losses totaling approximately $5 billion plus interest and costs"

controles.affirmation: Reglement avec Greensill Bank en juin 2026 (reclamations d'environ 3 Mds $) ; provision brute de 425 M$ comptabilisee au T1 2026
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q 21/07/2026 : "In June 2026, Marsh Ltd., Marsh Pty Ltd. and other parties reached a settlement with Greensill Bank and its insolvency administrator. Greensill Bank and its insolvency administrator had claimed losses totaling approximately $3 billion plus interest and costs. The Company recorded a gross liability of $425 million in the first quarter of 2026 in connection with the Australian proceedings."

controles.affirmation: La provision inclut la meilleure estimation du management pour les reclamations restantes de Credit Suisse : ce n'est pas un montant definitif
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q 21/07/2026 : "The recorded liability reflects the settlement with Greensill Bank and management's best estimate of the costs and losses associated with the remaining claims in the Australian proceedings brought by Credit Suisse. Due to ongoing negotiations and the complexity of the proceedings..."
controles.correction_proposee: Aucune erreur. Omission notable : le meme 10-Q chiffre la reclamation residuelle de Credit Suisse ("Credit Suisse has claimed losses totaling approximately $2 billion plus interest and costs"). Citer ce 2 Mds $ face aux 425 M$ provisionnes renforcerait l'argument sans rien inventer.

controles.affirmation: Le 10-K precise que dans beaucoup de dossiers aucune provision n'est constituee au-dela des frais de defense
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "In many cases, the Company has not recorded a liability, other than for legal fees to defend a claim, because we are unable, at the present time, to make a determination that a loss is both probable and reasonably estimable."
